video_title: Jaylin Sellers - “I Got Signed to the Chicago Bulls” | Episode 1

quotes.speaker: Jaylin Sellers
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylin Sellers on his growth as a player and person
quotes.excerpt: I feel like that I'm going to grow on them of a liking, of a player and not only as a player but as a person as well.
quotes.quote: Throughout the season they're going to see me get better. They're going to see me progress throughout this whole situation that I am in. I feel like that I'm going to grow on them of a liking, of a player and not only as a player but as a person as well.

quotes.speaker: Jaylin Sellers
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylin Sellers on the mental and physical demands of the draft process
quotes.excerpt: When you're going through the process of working out for teams and trying to find time in between to keep your game sharp, I think that it's a lot on you mentally and physically.
quotes.quote: When you're going through the process of working out for teams and trying to find time in between to keep your game sharp, I think that it's a lot on you mentally and physically. There's times that you're going to be tired, there's times where you're going to have back-to-backs and you have to stay focused and you're going to be traveling on the road.

quotes.speaker: Jaylin Sellers
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylin Sellers on handling the uncertainty of the NBA draft
quotes.excerpt: For me, it was just stay the course, trusting my work and trusting the vision that God has shown for me.
quotes.quote: This is a different situation, but I feel like I've been through these things before. Going through the process throughout high school, I was uncertain of where I was going to be at. COVID happened, I was getting Division 1 offers, I was getting JUCO offers. For me, it was just stay the course, trusting my work and trusting the vision that God has shown for me.

quotes.speaker: Jaylin Sellers
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylin Sellers on his long-term commitment to his career
quotes.excerpt: Either way, I ain't planning for one night. I'm planning for the next 15.
quotes.quote: Either way, I ain't planning for one night. I'm planning for the next 15.

quotes.speaker: Jaylin Sellers
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylin Sellers on his journey from scratch to the NBA
quotes.excerpt: When I hear my name called, it's a scratch. When I sign that book, it's from scratch.
quotes.quote: When I hear my name called, it's a scratch. When I sign that book, it's from scratch. Nobody was here for me when I was hurt, but the people that's here, nobody was here for me. When nobody was here for me, but now they trying to be here for me.

quotes.speaker: Jaylin Sellers
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylin Sellers on his confidence in his draft prospects
quotes.excerpt: I just don't feel like there's 60 players that's better than me in this draft.
quotes.quote: When around 55 came, I left the room. I no longer wanted to sit in there no more. I no longer wanted to hear people name called before me, because quite frankly, humbly speaking, I just don't feel like there's 60 players that's better than me in this draft. And I'm confident in that, and only time will tell.

quotes.speaker: Jaylin Sellers
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylin Sellers on his future success after the draft
quotes.excerpt: They're going to check back in 5-6 years, they're going to wish they had me.
quotes.quote: They're going to check back in 5-6 years, they're going to wish they had me. You ain't gotta hold me to it. You just open your eyes and open your ears.
